_comment: Known scenario for test/e2e/opportunity-register.spec.mjs. One waterflood opportunity with explicit measured inputs and an explicit deduction ledger; expected values come from js/potential.js and js/analogues.js at tool 2.1.2.

opportunity.name: Llanos Screening Block
opportunity.thesis: Fixture scenario for the run-capture tests: one waterflood asset with explicit measured inputs so every output is deterministic.

factors.label: Areal sweep efficiency
factors.note: Screening default read off a mobility ratio of 2.22.

factors.label: Vertical sweep and layering
factors.note: Screening default. Replace with a Dykstra-Parsons value once layer permeabilities exist.

factors.label: Well access and integrity
factors.note: Share of the well stock that can actually be worked.

factors.label: Facility and processing limit
factors.note: Hard ceiling in kboe/d imposed by the plant. Zero means no limit recorded.

factors.label: Water handling and injection capacity
factors.note: Voidage replacement the surface plant can actually support.

factors.label: Power and utilities
factors.note: Availability of electrical supply and utilities.

factors.label: Capex and schedule
factors.note: What can be funded and executed inside the plan window.

factors.label: Legal, sanctions and contracting
factors.note: Access to services, equipment and markets. Set below 1 where screening says so.

factors.label: Subsurface uncertainty contingency
factors.note: Explicit reserve against the analogue inputs being wrong.
